title: Hedgehog holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- Body / spines (hedgehog back) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- Spines - darker brown triangles around the top -->
  <polygon points='28,60 32,44 38,58' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <polygon points='36,54 42,38 48,52' fill='#6B4423'/>
  <polygon points='46,52 52,36 58,52' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <polygon points='56,54 62,38 68,54' fill='#6B4423'/>
  <polygon points='64,58 70,44 76,60' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <polygon points='24,66 24,50 32,62' fill='#6B4423'/>
  <polygon points='70,62 76,50 78,66' fill='#6B4423'/>
  <!-- Belly / face area -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#D4A76A'/>
  <!-- Face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#F0C896'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='63' r='3' fill='#2E1B0E'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='63' r='3' fill='#2E1B0E'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='62' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='62' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='69' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#2E1B0E'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='68.5' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45,73 Q50,77 55,73' stroke='#2E1B0E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='70' r='3' fill='#F5A0A0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='70' r='3' fill='#F5A0A0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Little arms holding heart -->
  <path d='M36,80 Q38,78 42,80' stroke='#C49A5C' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64,80 Q62,78 58,80' stroke='#C49A5C' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d='M50,92 C50,92 38,84 38,77 C38,72 42,70 46,72 C48,73 50,75 50,75 C50,75 52,73 54,72 C58,70 62,72 62,77 C62,84 50,92 50,92 Z' fill='#FF4466'/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='78' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF8899' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='85' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#C49A5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='85' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#C49A5C'/>
</svg>
